description: Luftdaten PM sensor locations is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Bristol City Council - Sustainability Team. Locations for Luftdaten PM (Air Quality) SDS011 sensors in Bristol. These are not operated or managed by Bristol City Council. Data are available through our open data portal. Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Environment, Transport & Streets, Energy. Its keywords are PM10, PM2.5, Air Quality, Air Pollution, Luftdaten. The portal shows 85 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
